Class CPUGovernorManager

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.core.CPUGovernorManager
public final class CPUGovernorManager extends Object
CPU Governor Manager for HFT Performance Optimization Controls CPU frequency scaling governors to ensure deterministic performance. Critical for trading applications that require consistent, predictable latency.
